proves.claim: mainRedFileExcuse treats a proof phase red only through failedFiles (a file that failed as a whole, no case named) as a file to compare with main, and excuses it when a main-test receipt is red at the input key the phase's ledger gives it.

api.gate.receipt-file-red-key.whole-file.why: Without it a file-level red (import error, crash) was refused as a red naming no case, so items sat on an unknown gate behind a main-red file.

proves.claim: A whole-file red is not excused when main measured only another input key, when its ledger has no keyed row for the file, or when the phase names neither a case nor a file.

api.gate.receipt-file-red-key.whole-file.why: Without the guard a file-level red could be excused on a guess, hiding the item's own failure.
